video-watermark-removal.name: Video watermark removal (MI-GAN / LaMa)
video-watermark-removal.description: Samples a representative frame, inpaints the watermark patch with MI-GAN — or LaMa in HD mode, or a temporal median when the background moves — then re-encodes the repaired frames with WebCodecs and muxes the original audio back with ffmpeg.wasm.

video-watermark-removal.name: Video watermark removal HD (LaMa)
video-watermark-removal.description: The HD pass of the video watermark pipeline: the representative frame is inpainted with big-lama fp32 (~198 MB) instead of MI-GAN, trading ~7x slower inference for markedly better reconstruction of large watermarks and structures crossing the selection edge. Runs on the WASM execution provider only — LaMa deadlocks on WebGPU — and auto mode never selects it; users opt in explicitly.
